title: Prejudgment seizure and attachment
summary: A prejudgment remedy restricts possession or use of property before final determination of liability. Attachment, garnishment, and replevin can protect a claimant but can also harm a person before the claim is proven.
notes: A bond or later damages action does not automatically eliminate the risk of erroneous deprivation. Nor does Fuentes invalidate every procedure involving provisional seizure.

sections.Meaning: A prejudgment remedy restricts possession or use of property before final determination of liability. Attachment, garnishment, and replevin can protect a claimant but can also harm a person before the claim is proven.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify what is seized or restricted, whether the applicant already has an interest in it, who authorizes the measure, what factual showing is required, whether a bond is required, and when the affected person can contest it. Compare Sniadach, Fuentes, and Doehr with the notes on different safeguards.
